services.name: Sunset Cruise
services.desc: Adults - $25 Senior (65+) / Military - $23 Kids (Ages 4 to 11) - $20 Kids 3 & Under - Free 1 Hour and 30 Minutes Looking for a way to relax? Experience sunset over the water on a 90-minute trip with the finest fleet of head boats on all of the East Coast. Our vessels each feature upper and lower sightseeing levels and interior windows that provide a 360-degree range for the ultimate viewing experience. What to Expect Dress for the weather! It can be slightly cooler out on the water especially in the spring, fall, and winter. We may have to cancel trips due to high winds, but RELAXING 90-MINUTE SUNSET CRUISE · All Ages!

services.name: Seal Spotting
services.desc: 3 Hours Adult: $37 Kid: $32 About Ready for a trip that gets a seal of approval? Look no further than an eco-excursion dedicated to viewing Virginia's sea puppies in their natural habitat: seal spotting! Our coastal waters host a variety of seal species, with harbor and gray seals being the most common sightings. What to Expect: Dress for the weather! It can be slightly cooler out on the water especially in the spring, fall, and winter. We may have to cancel trips due to high winds, but our cruises will still go when it is raining. Your comfort is a priority! We want to ensure 3-HOUR EXCURSION HARBOR & GRAY SEALS · Ages 4+

services.name: Whale Watching
services.desc: Adults (Ages 11 to 64) - $35 Senior (65+) / Military - $33 Kids (Ages 4 to 11) - $28 Kids 3 & Under - $5 Duration ~2 Hours Come experience an unforgettable trip to see incredible views of the world’s largest and most beautiful marine mammals. Our knowledgeable captain and crew will lead you on an educational journey along the Atlantic coast in search of whales, dolphins, seals, and several species of birds. The highlight of these trips is spotting humpback whales, which can often be seen breaching, flipper slapping or tail lobbing. With 40+ years of experience navigating our coastal 2 HOUR WHALE WATCH · All Ages · GUARANTEED SIGHTINGS

services.name: Cocktail Cruise
services.desc: Adults (21+ only) - $35 90 minutes Catch the spirit of the summer by joining us on a Cocktail Cruise featuring our local partner, Chesapeake Bay Distillery. Enjoy sunset over the water as you sip a selection of regional craft spirits on this unique adult-oriented trip. This is a 21 and over event. A valid photo ID is required at check in. What to Expect Dress for the weather! It will be slightly cooler out on the water. Layers and close-toed shoes with traction are recommended. Trips may be cancelled due to high winds creating unfavorable boating conditions, but will be Sunset Cruise with Chesapeake Bay Distillery · Adults

services.name: Night Fishing
services.desc: Adults - $40 Senior (65+) / Military - $38 Kids (Ages 4 to 11) - $30 3 Hours and 30 Minutes Fishing with our experts as the sun goes down is the perfect way to wind down your day! Join our experienced captain & crew as we head towards the Chesapeake Bay for a relaxing evening of fishing. For these family-friendly trips, we are mainly targeting croakers, spot, seatrout, roundhead, and small sharks. Our team on board is ready to help you every step of the trip to ensure that fisherfolks of all levels have a great time! What to Expect Everything is furnished for your fishing needs June 20 - August 8 · Evening Fishing For The Whole Family! · All Ages!

services.name: Half-Day Fishing
services.desc: Adults - $50 Senior (65+) / Military - $48 Kids (Ages 4 to 11) - $42 4 Hours Fishing fun for the whole family! Head towards the Chesapeake Bay with our experienced team fishing for croakers, seatrout (weakfish), roundhead, spot, and small sharks! This trip is perfect for anglers of all ages and experiences. What to Expect •Everything is furnished for your fishing needs – rod, reel, bait, tackle, fish bags & fishing license. Fish can be cleaned on board for a small fee. Departs from Rudee Inlet at the Virginia Beach Fishing Center. Please allow additional time for parking, which Daily Memorial Day - Labor Day · All Ages

services.name: Winter Wildlife Excursion
services.desc: Adults (12 and Up!) - $60 Senior (65+) / Military - $58 Kids (Ages 4 to 11) - $55 4 Hours Join us for a unique exploration of the coast in search of a variety of marine mammals and seabirds! This is a trip you will not want to miss, as the Mid-Atlantic provides a critical habitat for many different species of animals. We will explore hot spots known for their exceptional sightings of birds and seals while experts on board provide information about the animals and current local research that is being conducted to better help protect them. •Our trip course will be determined by SEALS, WHALES, DOLPHINS, & SEABIRDS · Ages 12+

services.name: 3/4 Day Fishing
services.desc: Adults (Ages 12 and Up) - $80 Kids (Ages 4 to 11) - $70 6 Hours Get Into the Bite! Offered in in the spring & fall, these action-packed trips will ease you back into the fishing state of mind. In April & May, we target tautog. In September & October, we shift our focus primarily to black sea bass and triggerfish with occasional flounder and bluefish. What to Expect Everything is furnished for your fishing needs – rod, reel, bait, tackle, fish bags & fishing license. Fish can be cleaned on board for a small fee. Departs from Rudee Inlet at the Virginia Beach Fishing Center. 6-HOUR FISHING

services.name: 1/2-Day Whale Watch
services.desc: Adults (12 and Up!) - $80 Duration ~5 Hours Ready for the ultimate whale adventure? Join our experts for an extended wildlife watching journey! During this ~5-hour trip, we will search for whales, dolphins, & seabirds that can be found in our coastal and near offshore waters. While we explore, we will be collecting data about the species we observe and their behaviors with researchers on board. •Our trip course will vary based upon current sightings, but may include various species of whales (humpback whales, fin whales, & minke whales), dolphins (bottlenose dolphins & common dolphins) 5-HOUR WHALE WATCH · Ages 12+

services.desc: Adults (Ages 12 and Up) - $125 Kids (Ages 4 to 11) - $125 9 Hours A Full Day of Fishing Fun! 9-hour excursion offered in May, September, October, & November targeting black sea bass, with triggerfish, bluefish, and flounder mixed in! services.name: Pelagic Wildlife Exploration
services.desc: Adults (12 and Up!) - $165 13 Hours Experience the diversity the offshore waters off of the Mid-Atlantic have to offer as we head to the deep for our latest exploration! Norfolk Canyon, about 70 miles offshore, is a unique biological community teeming with wildlife. Join us as we head out to view the marine life that call this Mid-Atlantic Canyon home. While we explore, we will be collecting data about the species we observe and their behaviors with researchers on board. •Our trip course will vary based upon current sightings, but may include various species of whales (fin 13-hour Offshore Trip: Whales, Dolphins, Seabirds · Ages 12+

quotes.author: EtownEater
quotes.text: Family fishing group of 9 (half day) from the ages of 7 to 61. The mates on board were extremely helpful and courteous. Providing everything you need for a good trip. Seas were a little rough the day we went but only had one minor seasickness case. Caught a lot of croaker. Small but was still fun. Reasonable pricing. Snacks on board are very reasonable. It is a memory my family will hold onto for a long time.

quotes.author: christinaf960604
quotes.text: My husband and I went on the sunset dolphin cruise a few weeks ago while visiting Virginia Beach and it was amazing! I was so impressed by the number of wild dolphins we encountered. We got to see the dolphins racing beside the boat and jumping in the air, all with a beautiful backdrop of the Virginia Beach skyline and beautiful summer sunset. I highly recommend for anybody visiting the Virginia Beach area.

We went to see some whales on Friday, January 31st. It was cold, but we made sure to wrap up real good. We were't sure if we were gonna see a whale as we drove forever. Then out of nowhere, a whale breached the water and it was on! We watched two humpback whales do their thing for around thirty minutes. It was awesome seeing these huge creatures in real life. This trip is definitely worth the money!!

I have always wanted to go on a whale watching trip. We were able to go on three tours with Rudee Tours in Virginia Beach. They did not disappoint! We saw at least five whales. The experience was unforgettable. The staff at Rudee's was so helpful and experienced. They made sure it was a great time for all. I hope to go again.

Great tour! Plenty of room on the boat for distancing etc and still see the dolphins. Capable and knowledgeable crew. Interesting narration telling about dolphin habits, habitat, etc made this an educational tour - a bonus because we expected to simply see the dolphins. Of course, the dolphins did not disappoint....

It was my first whale watching tour. During certain times of the year the whale sightings are guaranteed. I was not able to take my own photo of the whales that we saw so I was so glad one of the crew took photos and had them available for purchase in the snack bar. We will definitely be back.
